rationale: At fa93cded4604868420c92628a6b0193357e8c4d1, config.example.json:108-123 (and candidate equivalents) must bind actual installed inputs, but hashing only node_modules/.pnpm/lock.yaml lets changed package/generated bytes reuse stale success, so use an audited content identity or leave those checks uncached; src/verificationRunner.ts:129-138,165-177 must ensure probes cannot invalidate the pinned inputs before receipt reuse, but a probe that edits tracked source and returns the same version output still obtains a cached pass, so revalidate immutable inputs after probes and before hits; both failures were reproduced with the exact pinned runner in focused in-memory checks, while declared-dependency changes, ordinary command mutations, live-owner timeout waiting and manual suite coverage are now corrected.
